C9000247.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 247 (An infinite finitely presented residually finite 2-group and a finitely presented nil algebra.; papers: An infinite finitely presented residually finite 2-group; An infinite finitely presented periodic group; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/247.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FR_CORE.statement: For all legal sufficiently large parameters, establish clean-start nonzero preservation and isolated normalization of every nonzero consecutive-cut interval.

C_FR_FAITHFUL.statement: Lemma fr:faithful, lines 840-891: simulation and preservation of nonzero upper words under arbitrary lower-level replacements.

C_FR_TOKEN_NORMALIZATION.statement: Lemma fr:token-normalization, lines 962-1010: isolated normalization for every nonzero consecutive-cut interval, including forged control states.

C_FR_CONTEXT.statement: Lemma fr:context, lines 472-538: actual bidirectional transitions are context safe, including adjacent transactions, and preserve block ownership from clean words.

C_FR_PALETTE_SOUNDNESS.statement: Lemma fr:palette-soundness, starting at line 304: clean palettes remain safe under interleavings, and complete palettes in nonzero words admit checker removal and idle sorting.

C_FR_VERIFICATION.statement: Lemma fr:verification, lines 549-572: exact bidirectional tour and gate soundness on fixed payload, including committed-side transport and semantic-zero edges.

C_FR_COMPLETE_ROLLBACK.statement: Lemma fr:rollback, starting at line 575, restricted to complete full regions; repaired cursor assertion requires the known first position and entire acquired prefix.

C_FR_TABLEAU.statement: Subsection fr:tableau, starting at line 618: the actual addressed clauses and fixed-point program certify exactly the next-parameter rule entries with uniform large-parameter bounds.

C_FR_CUT_GRAMMAR.statement: In every locally admissible consecutive-cut interval, syntax forces one to k complete blocks and either one complete transaction or one idle block, without a missing-left-endpoint case.

C_FR_FRAGMENT_BOUND.statement: Lemma fr:fragment-bound, starting at line 919: nonzero palette fragments have length at most 16q+2 and cut-free intervals have bounded length even at word ends.

C_FR_TRUNCATED_CURSOR_COUNTEREXAMPLE.statement: At every legal large parameter, the nonzero singleton B at C(2) is a locally admissible truncated cursor region with no replacement or release.

C_FR_CURSOR_SOURCE_GUARDS.statement: All actual unary boundary-cursor sources occur at C(1) or S; all other unary controls have marker F. The concrete B at C(2) is unary-format-valid and has no unary zero.

C_FR_CURSOR_NONZERO.statement: The concrete singleton maps to a nonzero square-zero matrix over every base field, with every defining relation respected.

C_FR_CURSOR_FORMAL_ISOLATION.statement: Uniform singleton isolation, nonzero status, and nonrelease in the explicitly enlarged projection of all relevant rule and zero source categories.

F_BOUNDARY_CURSOR_ROLLBACK_WITHOUT_LEFT_.statement: A boundary-cursor region can always be released inside its acquired interval.

C_FR_MATRIX_NIL_DOWNSTREAM.statement: September cancellation.tex: ca:all-tests and thm:algebra use the hierarchy to obtain the infinite finitely presented matrix-nil graded algebra.

C_FR_PERIODIC_GROUP_DOWNSTREAM.statement: September thm:main additionally requires ordinary finite presentability, infinitude, and Steinberg-kernel torsion; the local scope erratum does not refute it.

C_FR_CANCELLATION_REDUCTIONS.statement: September cancellation.tex: direct cancellation, token/chunk reduction, automaton conversion, and the dimension bounds combine to prove ca:all-tests and matrix nilpotence.

C_FR_STEINBERG_FINITE_PRESENTATION.statement: The finite presentation of the constructed unital algebra gives an ordinary finite presentation of St_12(R), without adding implicit identities.

C_FR_STEINBERG_KERNEL_TORSION.statement: The kernel J_12(R) of St_12(R) to E_12(R) is torsion; periodicity of the elementary image alone does not establish this.

C_FR_STEINBERG_INFINITUDE.statement: Infinitely many parameters in the constructed ring give distinct elementary matrices and therefore infinitely many elements of St_12(R).
